You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

  "headline": "The dal-OUTCOMES trial of dalcetrapib in 15,871 patients with recent acute coronary syndrome was stopped early for futility after an independent DSMB found no clinically meaningful efficacy, consistent with the calculator's prediction of a 5.3% probability of success driven by HDL-C being a non-causal biomarker for coronary disease.",
  "summary": "The phase 3 dal-OUTCOMES trial randomized 15,871 stable coronary heart disease patients with recent acute coronary syndrome to dalcetrapib 600 mg daily or placebo on top of evidence-based care, targeting 1,600 primary endpoint events (coronary heart disease death, nonfatal MI, unstable angina hospitalization, resuscitated cardiac arrest, or atherothrombotic stroke). On 7 May 2012, Roche announced the independent DSMB recommended stopping the trial for lack of clinically meaningful efficacy, with no safety signal. The calculator predicted this outcome: because HDL-C is classified as non-causal for coronary disease, the expected benefit via the modest LDL-C lowering observed in phase 2 (-5% within-arm, not placebo-adjusted, in a different population) was only a 1.7% relative risk reduction (expected HR 0.983), yielding just 5.3% power with 1,600 events and ~2.5 years follow-up. The minimum detectable HR for 80% power was 0.869, far from the expected 0.983. Genetic evidence for CETP causality was absent at trial launch (all 13 Open Targets items published after 2012-05-07), and the calculator's weakest link was 'target genetics: uncertain.'",
